shared_changes.description: The normal linear model definition cites unopened Fisher 1925, Gauss 1809 and Davison 2003 as if each supported modern iid-normal wording. Opened Kulich 2022 §§1.1–1.3 pp. 6–8 supplies the exact matrix and simple-regression model; preserve the definition and separate historical uses of original citations only after original passages are read. Recheck its dependent probability pages.

The heart-rate regression example and nearby sampling theorem have inherited Fox 2016 and Casella–Berger 2002 citations not fully verified in the page ranges. Opened Kulich 2022 §1.3 p. 8 and ISLR 2013 Ch. 3 §§3.1–3.3 pp. 61–101 support regression formulas and exact pivot claims. Preserve the heart-rate table and all results; retain it as source-chapter data, add located general-formula citations, and check dependent inference pages.
